segments.name: Electric vehicle
segments.description: Designs, installs and sells smart E-motorcycles, E-bikes and E-scooters, plus rentals, to customers in the United States.
segments.evidence: Because the CODM makes resource allocation and performance assessment decisions based on consolidated results, the Company has determined that it has only one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Retail and wholesale customers pay for smart E-bikes, E-motorcycles, E-scooters and accessories; rental customers pay for e-bike rentals.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates substantially all its revenues from sales of products such as smart E-bikes, E-motorcycles, E-scooters and accessories to the retail and wholesale customers through its wholly owned subsidiaries stores.
